why: Today a controller with the backpack open can only move the highlight up and down through the grid (D-UP and D-DOWN send ArrowUp and ArrowDown to raidKey); there is no way to pick an item up or put it on a belt key, because that only exists as a mouse press on a cell (cv mousedown starts G.drag) and a mouse release over a belt cell or off the belt (the window mouseup does the assign, swap, unbind and every message). The draft adds a belt row to the highlight walk (G.bagBelt, G.bagBeltSel: down off the bottom of the grid or up off its top lands on the tactical belt, left and right walk along it, up and down return to the grid, and an empty grid still reaches the belt), routes pad D-LEFT and D-RIGHT to ArrowLeft and ArrowRight while the backpack is open, and makes pad A call bagPadAct, which pins the cursor to the highlighted cell and fires the same mousedown on the canvas (pick up) or the same mouseup on the window (place) that the mouse fires, so every drop rule, swap, refusal and message is the mouse one. While a pad drag is held the cursor sits on the highlight so the ghost and the ringed drop target draw there. The belt draws a gold ring on the highlighted key, the grid ring steps aside while the highlight is on the belt, and the backpack header and hint name A and B on a pad (the old hint named D-LEFT drop, which v16.72 removes). A keeps its own last-state latch because the v16.72 tap loop stamps PAD.prev for A before this block runs.
